prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: concussion. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1098; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a side impact collision at a signalized intersection. Insured vehicle was struck on the driver side by a third-party vehicle that entered on a red signal, per the initial statement. Police report requested. Claimant reports concussion symptoms and has retained counsel, who has requested that all further contact be routed through their office.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant's attorney's office to confirm representation and acknowledge the claim. Counsel stated that medical records and a treatment summary will be forwarded once available. Liability appears clear on preliminary review, but coverage and damages remain under evaluation. Reserve set pending records.

Entry 3: Reviewed photos of both vehicles. Driver-side door intrusion and deployed side curtain airbag on the claimant's vehicle are noted. Third-party vehicle shows front-end damage consistent with the reported angle of impact. Vehicle inspection scheduled with the appraiser and a copy sent to counsel.

Entry 4: Received intake records from the treating provider through claimant's counsel. Diagnosis listed as concussion with post-concussive headaches and dizziness. Neurology referral noted. Medical file flagged for nurse review. No further contact with claimant directly, per counsel's request.

Entry 5: Claim reviewed with supervisor. Liability position confirmed as favorable to the insured based on the police report and witness statement. Demand package expected from counsel. Will follow up on the outstanding treatment records and schedule a reserve review once the medical summary is received.
